data.name: Diva Royale - Drag Queen Show Chicago
data.headline: Starting at $40.07 • Weekly Drag Queen Shows • Fridays 7:00PM • Saturdays 7:00PM • Sundays 1:30PM
data.description:
##The finest drag queen dinner, brunch shows, and female celebrity impersonations in the world!

##Rates (Including Taxes and Fees)
- **General Admission** - $40.07
- **VIP Admission Guaranteed VIP seating • Expedited entry** - $68.70
- **General Admission with 3-Course Meal Food currently not available at this location, just drinks.** - $70.44
- **VIP Admission with 3-Course Meal Food currently not available at this location, just drinks.** - $97.53
- **VIP Group Discount - Up to 10 People Group discount • Guaranteed VIP seating and expedited entry** - $515.21
- **VIP Group Discount - Up to 15 People Group discount • Guaranteed VIP seating and expedited entry** - $801.46
- **VIP Group Discount - Up to 20 People Group discount • Guaranteed VIP seating and expedited entry** - $1030.44
- **VIP Group Discount - Up to 25 People Group discount • Guaranteed VIP seating and expedited entry** - $1259.44
- **Hot Seat on Stage (Not an Admission Ticket) Bring your special diva on stage during the show** - $68.70
- **Upgrade General Admission to VIP Admission (Add-On) For existing General Admission ticket holders** - $28.62

##About
Get up close and personal with your host, Diva Drag Queen and her guest drag queen divas such as Madonna, Dolly Parton, Celine Dion, Liza Minnelli, Adele, Nicki Minaj, Whitney Houston, Sia, Brittany Spears, Beyonce, and many other celebrity impersonators (specific celebrity drag queens vary according to city, location, and date).

The Diva Royale restaurant is the ultimate drag dining experience and Chicago's #1 bachelorette party and gay bachelor party haven! The queens of Diva Royale love to host the hottest and best bachelorette parties, birthday parties and all kinds of celebrations! Dinner or brunch will be a celebration you won't forget, where you are treated like a Queen! Diva Royale Chicago is open on Fridays and Saturdays for dinner shows and Sundays for brunch shows. **Advance tickets only!**

Purchasing food is not mandatory, but only prepaid dinner or brunch packages will be served.

##Age Limit
21+

##Duration
1 hour

data.booking_notes:
##Doors open 30 minutes prior to showtime.

##Important information:

- The credit card used to purchase your tickets and a government-issued photo ID are required to enter the club.
- General admission ticket holders are subject to outside wait and standing room only.
- Seating within each section (even VIP sections) is on a first-come, first-serve basis. Arrive early for best seats in your section. Latecomers may be admitted and seated at the discretion of the house management. Exact seat sections are not guaranteed once the event begins.
- Locations, showtimes, and show venues are subject to change with or without notice.
- Some venues require a mandatory coat check.
